{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
non_qa_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Final population: non-QA completed orders
final_population = non_qa_completed

# Compute average revenue per completed order (after removing QA and refunded)
avg_revenue = final_population['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Final count
final_count = len(final_population)

# Print final result
print(f'Final number of completed orders (non-QA): {final_count}')
print(f'Average revenue per non-QA completed order: {avg_revenue}')"}
